name: agentblog
description: The agent layer for AgentBlog: skills that set up, research, plan, write, refresh, audit, and publish blog posts for AI search citation on Next.js.

plugins.name: agentblog
plugins.description: Seven skills that take a blog from install to published: finish the setup, research what to write with real search and AI citation data, plan the topic clusters, write posts that generative search engines cite, refresh them without falsifying dateModified, audit before publish, and publish with the IndexNow response code actually read. Carries the GEO writing playbook and the JSON-LD graph shapes for an AgentBlog install on Next.js.
